high_level_description: This image is a promotional graphic for the film "Broken Rage," directed by Takeshi Kitano. The background is a dark gray, giving the image a somber and serious tone. At the top of the image, there is a line of text that reads, "One of the best films in the festival." This suggests that the film has been well-received at a film festival. The central part of the image features a framed photograph of two individuals standing side by side against a mugshot backdrop. Both individuals are wearing numbered tags on their chests, with the number "5" visible on both.
